definition: the feeling of having nothing interesting to do
description: A cartoon man in a purple tracksuit waits in a laundromat and slowly loses his mind from boredom: he watches the clock, balances stacked cups on his head, blows a feather, spins his laundry bag on one finger, slides off his chair and ends up wearing a wet sock on his head.

taps.phrase: to slump in a plastic chair

de.answer: Er sitzt zusammengesunken in einem Plastikstuhl.
